ops.new:
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ 1.2.2: the floating report icon
local okBc, errBc = pcall(function()
    local B = F.Beacon
    check("beacon: the module loaded", type(B) == "table" and type(B.Set) == "function" and type(B.ReportText) == "function")
    F.db.beacon = nil
    F:ClearMiss()
    check("beacon: off until the player says yes", B.IsOn() == false)
    B.Set(true)
    local ic = B.Frame()
    check("beacon: switching on shows the icon", B.IsOn() == true and ic ~= nil and ic:IsShown())
    F:Miss("tpl", "zz beacon line #", "Zz beacon line 5.", "Test")
    check("beacon: a new find makes the frame blink", B.Flashing() == true)
    check("beacon: the counter shows the count", ic.badge.count:GetText() == "1", ic.badge.count:GetText())
    local txt = B.ReportText()
    check("beacon: the report line has the status-page format", txt:find("misses=1", 1, true) ~= nil
        and txt:find("tpl :: Zz beacon line 5. :: Test :: x1", 1, true) ~= nil, txt)
    Click(ic, "LeftButton")
    local w = B.Window()
    check("beacon: a click opens the report window", w ~= nil and w:IsShown())
    check("beacon: the window holds the report text", (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("Zz beacon line 5.", 1, true) ~= nil, w.box:GetText())
    check("beacon: the window says the icon is on, in Persian", non_ascii(w.status:GetText()), w.status:GetText())
    Click(w.toggle)
    check("beacon: the window button turns the icon off", B.IsOn() == false and not ic:IsShown())
    Click(w.toggle)
    check("beacon: and on again", B.IsOn() == true and ic:IsShown())
    Click(w.clear)
    check("beacon: clearing the list empties the counter", F.db.missN == 0 and not ic.badge:IsShown(), F.db.missN)
    Click(ic, "RightButton")
    local m = B.MenuFrame()
    check("beacon: a right click opens the menu", m ~= nil and m:IsShown())
    Click(m.hide)
    check("beacon: the menu hides the icon", B.IsOn() == false and not ic:IsShown() and not m:IsShown())
    w:Hide()
    F.OpenPanel("health")
    local PF = F.PanelFrame()
    check("beacon: the switch is on the status page", PF.beacon ~= nil)
    Click(PF.beacon)
    check("beacon: the panel switch turns the icon on", B.IsOn() == true and ic:IsShown())
    Click(PF.beacon)
    check("beacon: and off", B.IsOn() == false)
    PF:Hide()
    B.ShowIntro(true)
    local it = B.IntroFrame()
    check("beacon: the intro opens on its first slide", it ~= nil and it:IsShown() and it.i == 1)
    Click(it.pri)
    check("beacon: the demo icon is on the second slide", it.i == 2 and it.demo:IsShown())
    Click(it.pri)
    check("beacon: the third slide offers the switch", it.i == 3 and not it.demo:IsShown())
    Click(it.pri)
    check("beacon: enable turns the icon on and closes the intro", B.IsOn() == true and not it:IsShown())
    B.Set(false)
    B.ShowIntro(true)
    Click(it.later)
    check("beacon: not now closes the intro and leaves the icon off", not it:IsShown() and B.IsOn() == false)
    F.db.beacon.asked = true
    B.ShowIntro()
    check("beacon: the intro is shown only once", not it:IsShown())
    -- 1.2.2: the aura time line with the client's plural escape, and a server-only system line
    F:ClearMiss()
    GameTooltip:Hide()
    GameTooltip:ClearLines()
    GameTooltip:AddLine("Zz Aura Time")
    GameTooltip:AddLine("29 |4minute:minutes; remaining")
    F.AuraTip(GameTooltip, nil)
    local als = GameTooltip:TipLines()
    local allt = table.concat(als, " / ")
    check("auras: the time left with the plural escape turns Persian", non_ascii(als[2]) and not allt:find("remaining", 1, true), allt)
    local rem = false
    for _, e in pairs(F.db.miss or {}) do
        if e.t and e.t:find("remaining", 1, true) then
            rem = true
        end
    end
    check("auras: that line is not noted as a miss", not rem)
    GameTooltip:Hide()
    check("sysmsg: a server-only line (named by its English) turns Persian", non_ascii(F.SysmsgPreview("You are no longer rested.")),
        tostring(F.SysmsgPreview("You are no longer rested.")))
end)
check("beacon tests ran", okBc, errBc)
check("items module not installed (locked)", not (F.mods.items and F.mods.items.active))
